title: Old Earth Hills
dek: Prima’s northeastern hills, reached from the First Forest by scrubland and switchback roads.
body:
The Old Earth Hills lie in northeastern Prima. The island map places their label north of The Before.

The road from the forest

During the 2 May 2024 journey through the First Forest, the trees become shorter and thinner toward the hills, giving way to bushes, scrubland, and switchback roads.

The hills are an exploration and hunting landscape. Their complete boundaries and internal sites remain unestablished.

19–27 September · the harpy cave

A return expedition finds a narrow tunnel that carries the Matron’s song beyond the earlier nesting ground. A distorted corpse, violet crystals with differing responses, altered harpies and a ghostlike remnant make the danger concrete; a direct connection to The Before remains Moira’s theory.

Deeper inside, the party discovers an unnamed dead person and a letter about a loved singer changed by violet corruption. The origins and sequence of the scattered Delerium fragments cannot be determined. Pell offers a last prayer. Saoirse’s Petalio strikes a weak support as the party withdraws, collapsing the passage; she takes the letter to seek an identification. Read the expedition and its consequences.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

The eastern wilderness

The Alpine Forest is described as lying beyond these hills to the east. That establishes a relative direction, not a surveyed distance or border. Read the forest’s exploration history.

Scene evidence: 1.
